name: Process-network link-health input
summary: Reports the defined physical or logical link condition on the assigned process-network connection.
description: Reports the defined physical or logical link condition on the assigned process-network connection. Digital substation interfaces carry measurements, status and control information between primary equipment and protective devices. Measurement streams, event messages and time synchronization are separate dependencies even when they share an Ethernet network.

In a digital substation bay, a merging unit digitizes local measurements and a protective relay subscribes to the assigned data stream. The command return path and communication-health indications are drawn separately. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Network port health” at the input and “Process-link alarm” at the output. A healthy link can still carry invalid application data.
